message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is normally **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During the brief overlap when the U.S. has already switched to daylight‑saving time but Germany has not yet done so (late March/early April), the gap shrinks to 8 hours. Otherwise it stays at 9 hours.
